query:
INSERT INTO blocks_entity
             (height, "minerAddress", worker, "sessionId", "blockData", mode)
           SELECT $1::bigint, $2::varchar, $3::varchar, $4::varchar, $5::varchar,
                  $6::varchar
           WHERE NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM blocks_entity WHERE height = $1 AND "blockData" = $5
           )
